# Dittle

> Notes that keep themselves up to date. Change a date, price or headcount in one note, and Dittle updates every other note that mentions it. Private, instant, works offline.

Dittle reads notes with Gemini Nano on the user's device (Chrome's Prompt API on the web, ML Kit on Android) and falls back to Gemini Flash through Firebase AI Logic when the device has no model. It was built for #BuildHybridAI 2026.

## Pages

- [Home](https://dittle.app/): what Dittle does, with a live demo
- [Sign in](https://dittle.app/signin): email, Google, or continue without an account
- [Create an account](https://dittle.app/signup)
